description: Why: every test file that constructs PeeringShared with a struct literal will fail to compile when a new field is added to PeeringShared, making refactors unnecessarily painful. What: fault_queue_full.rs, rfc4644_streaming.rs, and other test files construct PeeringShared via exhaustive struct literal syntax. PeeringShared should provide a builder or Default impl so tests only need to set the fields they care about.
title: PeeringShared struct literal construction in tests will break on any field addition
